name: exemplo-drizzle-sqlite
description: Exemplo Drizzle ORM + SQLite em camadas (routes/controller/service/repository), db instanciado no server

scripts.db:reset: node -e "['app.db','app.db-shm','app.db-wal'].forEach(f=>require('fs').rmSync('data/'+f,{force:true}))" && npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
